task.title: Obtaining database configuration information
task.shortdesc: To obtain database configuration information for your Red Hat Quay deployment, you can use oc exec for Operator deployments or podman exec for standalone deployments to read postgresql.conf from the database pod or container.

note.p: Interacting with the PostgreSQL database is potentially destructive. Red Hat recommends that you perform the following procedure with a Red Hat Quay Support Specialist.
